title: Kid Mode: Last Check Before Publishing

items.title: What's on This Page
items.why:
Kid mode is built from your picks (2.32.0) and passes its checks. These are the pieces you haven't seen in a picture yet. Every picture is the real built app.

Nothing is published until you answer the last card.

items.title: The Grown-Ups Screen
items.why:
After the passcode: the prize list you approved, then how hard the push-ups and plank are, and one or two rounds. Lennon starts on wall push-ups and a knee plank, one round. A grown-up moves him up here when it's easy.

If no passcode is set yet, the first tap on Grown-ups asks a grown-up to make one (6 digits, as the app uses now). The "Add a passcode later" link is hidden here, so the grown-up area can't open without one.

items.title: Open the Full App
items.why: Shows the normal app with a bar on top. Back to Kid Mode returns to his screen. Closing the app also returns to kid mode.

items.title: 90 Days Makes the Row Crowded
items.why:
Your note asked for 90 days. It's a new choice on the passcode screen and in Settings, for everyone, and Lennon's tablet starts on 90.

With five buttons the row is cramped on a phone: "Always Ask" no longer fits its button.

options.label: A dropdown
options.desc: Like the other choice lists you picked.

items.title: Stop and the Plank
items.why:
Each move has a Stop for Today link. Stopping ends the workout, and a Dragon Ball needs all 5 stars.

The plank is held, so the circle starts a 20-second countdown and the star comes at 0.

items.title: The New Drawings
items.why:
Your ChatGPT drawings, cut into start and end pictures. They show in kid mode and, for everyone, on wall push-ups, knee push-ups, bodyweight squats, knee planks and planks (adult pictured: the exercise info for knee push-ups).

Two small differences from the brief: in the curl-up his hands rest on his thighs instead of sliding along the floor, and the star jump starts standing tall instead of crouched.

options.label: Kid mode only
options.desc: Adults keep no picture on these moves.

items.title: Publish 2.32.0?
items.why: Only Lennon's profile changes, plus the passcode choice and the new drawings. Erica's iRob look comes next.
